grain.timingScope: Completed process wall; diagnostic only. Endpoint power is recorded; historical-control/new-grain durations are not a performance comparison.

execution.scope: Control timing/resources are historical and power conditions were not controlled as a matched pair. The new grain capture uses recorded power for numerical comparison only; launch supply and endpoint observations are retained. No new-grain versus earlier-control timing/RSS comparison is made. Process wall includes startup, inference, readback and disk writes; sampled RSS/free disk and endpoint power do not establish throughput or continuous power.

independentAudit.scope: Independent raw-pixel replay and exact report/CSV comparison; all frame, adjacent and pooled metrics match without a numerical tolerance or quality threshold.

limitations: No natural film-grain realism, exact zero-mean field, gain ratio, quality threshold or perceptual classification.
Paired differences do not isolate noise, history, estimated flow or reconstruction as their sole cause.
Public reset/model/motion-request fields do not reveal the actual selected flow backend or reset cause.
Onset24 and removal36 have separate adjacent-change groups; no event or reset observation is excluded.
Historical binary/model/source provenance is compared and retained, not re-executed by this analyzer.
No playback, physical display or sustained source-rate acceptance.
Actual raw payloads and model files are retained separately, not embedded in this public evidence.
Private noise indices, incoming history, flow arrays and confidence are not observed by these four-view captures.
metricDefinition: Same ordinal and source coordinates. Convert all Float32 RGB components to Float64 BEFORE subtraction; all components equally weighted, no luminance weighting.
pooledDefinition: RMS=sqrt(sumSquares/componentCount), not mean frame RMS. Maximum ties select earliest current ordinal then top-to-bottom row-major RGB component.

prelaunchRefusal.scope: Attempt 1 refused launch on Battery Power at 99%; no model process or grain raw output was produced. Original reports/config/wrapper remain retained.

publicationVerification.scope: Every consumed file is initially SHA256-pinned. Before publication, files up to 8 MiB (reports, CSV and source scripts) are rehashed; larger runtime/model files receive alias/device/inode/size/mtime/ctime checks only, not a second hash. Raw payloads are verified by the pinned analyzer and independent audit, not reread by this exporter.

recipe.arithmeticScope: Factors31/32 and33/32 are exactly representable. Product exactness is tested and recorded for this selected scale; any Float32 rounding remains in the stored originals.
recipe.capturePolicy: One fresh persistent processor; supply all48 frames with normal automatic motion, noise/history evolution and reset policy. Event truth is not a reset directive.
recipe.fieldExpansion: Each cell becomes exactly2x2 source pixels. Stored signed int8 field is source-sized, top-left origin, +x right/+y down, row-major.
recipe.hashMessage: ASCII(seed), with no terminator or separator, followed by sourceFrameIndex uint32LE then blockCounter uint32LE.
recipe.meanScope: Cell signs are not balanced after hashing. Realized sign/contrast mean is recorded, not forced to zero; nominal achromatic factors do not assert exact chromaticity after rounding.
recipe.name: sha256-cell-contrast-grain-v1
recipe.scene: Pinned occlusion scene_assets(scale), render(index=0); clean base is never regenerated per frame.
recipe.scope: Synthetic deterministic grain-like multiplicative contrast on linear BT.2020 RGB working inputs. CPU preparation only; no natural film-grain realism, exact zero mean, neural quality, reset cause, physical HDR presentation or source-rate qualification.
recipe.sourceOperation: Elementwise Float32(baseRGB * Float32(1 + sign/32)); the same factor is selected for R/G/B, with no clipping.
recipe.stream: Concatenate SHA256 digests for blockCounter=0,1,...; unpack each byte LSB-first; take first cellCount bits in row-major cell order.

resetScope: Observed public flags, with no reset-cause or actual motion-backend claim.
scope: One new 48-frame synthetic grain-like capture compared with the retained static control on unchanged production runtime/model; no control model rerun.
